The original self-contained .gltf assets were losslessly repackaged into GLB.
Geometry, palette materials, skeletons, animations and node names are unchanged.
These are original stylized animal assets, not third-party game or anime IP.
Credit is not required by CC0; the provenance is retained here for clarity.
